name: Cyberscope Browser
summary:
Browse the web like normal. When a video starts, Cyberscope opens it in a real VR player: a big flat screen, 3D, or all around you in 180 and 360.

MADE FOR WATCHING
• Videos on most sites open in VR automatically, or with the Play in VR button
• Flat, 3D side-by-side and over-under, 180, 360 and fisheye, detected for you
• Passthrough for green-screen and alpha videos
• AI passthrough (beta) and 2D to 3D (beta), run on the headset itself
• Picture, speed, equalizer, volume boost, A-B loop, subtitles, Conti
